title: Watchlist page — requirements & RTM (feature inventory v1, from locked review board)
derived_from: Developer feature inventory 2026-11-26; 40 features; ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148 RTM shape mapped onto project psrs format

requirements.text: The app shell SHALL show brand, sync, notifications with badge, and avatar on every screen.

acceptance_criteria.then: top bar shows brand, sync, bell with badge, avatar

requirements.text: Watchlist SHALL show sticky ADD FORM and LEDGER tabs with live counts.

acceptance_criteria.then: tabs stay pinned and counts match ledger totals

requirements.text: The stat strip SHALL show WATCHING and ALERTS counts above content.

acceptance_criteria.then: numbers equal the ledger and alert totals

requirements.text: Bottom navigation SHALL provide five tabs and mark Watchlist active.

acceptance_criteria.then: it navigates and Watchlist is highlighted while on the page

requirements.text: The FAB SHALL open the Add Bond form on Dashboard, Portfolio and Watchlist, and the Goal form on Goals.

acceptance_criteria.then: the page-specific form opens (Add Bond or Goal form)

requirements.text: The app SHALL surface critical rating-watch alerts as an alert card with severity and advisory text.

acceptance_criteria.then: the card shows severity Critical and the advisory body

requirements.text: The alert card SHALL offer Read Advisory and Dismiss actions.

acceptance_criteria.then: advisory opens or the card is dismissed

requirements.text: The Add Bond form SHALL stay hidden until the FAB or ADD FORM tab is tapped.

acceptance_criteria.then: no form is shown; tapping + reveals it

requirements.text: The lookup SHALL accept a 12-character ISIN and run Fetch.

acceptance_criteria.then: the lookup runs and a result state is shown

requirements.text: The lookup SHALL indicate Found, Checking, Offline and Not Found states.

acceptance_criteria.then: the matching state indicator renders

requirements.text: A duplicate active ISIN SHALL be blocked with guidance naming the existing broker.

acceptance_criteria.given: an ISIN already active in the watchlist
acceptance_criteria.then: a red error banner shows guidance and the existing broker; save is blocked

requirements.text: Identity fields SHALL auto-fill from fetch and the ISIN SHALL be a locked immutable chip.

acceptance_criteria.then: company, rating, agency are filled and ISIN shows a lock chip

requirements.text: Economics fields SHALL mark auto versus user-entered sources.

acceptance_criteria.then: auto fields carry auto chips and Expected Yield stays user-empty

requirements.text: Issuer type, listing status and maturity date SHALL auto-fill from fetch.

acceptance_criteria.then: all three fields are populated with auto chips

requirements.text: The form SHALL capture the interest credit day of month (1-31).

acceptance_criteria.when: a day 1-31 is entered and saved
acceptance_criteria.then: the value persists with the position

requirements.text: Default History SHALL be a disabled field with a COMING SOON chip until background automation ships.

acceptance_criteria.then: the field is disabled and shows the COMING SOON chip

requirements.text: The Secured NCD flag SHALL display with helper text explaining the senior claim.

acceptance_criteria.then: value and helper text are visible

requirements.text: Target Invested and Planned Quantity SHALL accept user input and start empty.

acceptance_criteria.then: both fields are empty and accept typed values

requirements.text: Value per unit SHALL compute Target Invested divided by Quantity, showing an em-dash until both are present.

acceptance_criteria.then: the quotient shows; with one missing it shows an em-dash

requirements.text: The broker field SHALL accept free-text entry (MVP); predefined suggestion chips are v1.1.

acceptance_criteria.then: it is accepted and saved

requirements.text: Save SHALL persist the watch entry with auto/user chips; Source Note is optional (v1.1).

acceptance_criteria.then: the entry appears in the ledger; the note field remains optional

requirements.text: The ledger SHALL group held and watch positions by company in one merged view.

acceptance_criteria.given: companies with held and watch ISINs
acceptance_criteria.then: one card per company contains both row types

requirements.text: Each company card SHALL show a four-tier status pill (Danger, Maturing, On-going, Matured).

acceptance_criteria.then: the pill uses the correct tier colour

requirements.text: The card header SHALL show total invested and bond/completed/ongoing counts.

acceptance_criteria.then: amount and counts match the underlying rows

requirements.text: Held ISIN rows SHALL show units, settled amount and maturing countdown.

acceptance_criteria.then: units, settled amount and countdown are visible

requirements.text: Watch rows SHALL show broker, cycle/date/structure meta, yield, and Move to Portfolio plus Details actions.

acceptance_criteria.then: meta and yield show; Move opens the form; Details opens the detail screen

requirements.text: The same ISIN at multiple brokers SHALL produce a compare card with yields and Best Yield.

acceptance_criteria.given: three broker rows for one ISIN
acceptance_criteria.then: all yields list, best is tagged, Select is offered

requirements.text: The compare card SHALL instruct the user to buy at the broker first, then return to Move to Portfolio.

acceptance_criteria.then: the buy-step line appears under Select

requirements.text: The page SHALL offer browsing the NSDL depository list.

acceptance_criteria.then: the depository list opens

requirements.text: Move to Portfolio SHALL capture purchased quantity, invested amount, execution date and broker reference.

acceptance_criteria.then: four inputs appear empty and editable

requirements.text: Move SHALL optionally attach an existing goal.

acceptance_criteria.when: one is selected in Link to Goal
acceptance_criteria.then: the new position is attached to that goal

requirements.text: The Update goals detour SHALL return to Move with all entered values intact.

acceptance_criteria.when: user detours to goals and returns
acceptance_criteria.then: every entered value is preserved

requirements.text: Confirm Move SHALL create a held position with a broker record note.

acceptance_criteria.then: the row becomes HELD/On-going and carries the broker note

requirements.text: Delete SHALL be buried: Details, overflow menu, bottom sheet, guarded dialog — never on-card.

acceptance_criteria.then: no on-card delete exists; the four-step chain is reachable

requirements.text: The overflow sheet SHALL list View history, Edit target, Share prospectus and Remove with destructive styling.

acceptance_criteria.then: four actions show with Remove styled red

requirements.text: Remove SHALL require typing the full ISIN and holding confirm for two seconds; held positions are never deleted here.

acceptance_criteria.when: wrong ISIN is typed or hold is too short
acceptance_criteria.then: removal is blocked; correct ISIN plus 2s hold removes only the watch entry

requirements.text: The dialog SHALL state that held positions are never deleted from watchlist.

acceptance_criteria.then: the held-never-deleted note is visible

requirements.text: First open SHALL default to the LEDGER tab with the form hidden and zeroed notification stats.

acceptance_criteria.given: a fresh install with no data
acceptance_criteria.then: LEDGER is active, form hidden, stats show zero states

requirements.text: The empty ledger SHALL show a placeholder with an Add first bond CTA.

acceptance_criteria.then: icon, headline and CTA show; tapping CTA opens the form

requirements.text: FAB route logic SHALL differ per page (Add Bond versus Goal form).

acceptance_criteria.then: the correct form for that page opens

prd_items.text: Core loop MVP: add a bond, see it in the integrated ledger, convert to portfolio or remove it.
Post-MVP: alerts surfacing, multi-broker compare with buy-step, NSDL bulk browse, goals integration, default-history automation.

test_cases.title: Shell bar presence (WL-A1)
test_cases.steps: 1. Open each of the five pages. 2. Inspect the top bar.
test_cases.expected: Brand, sync, bell with badge, avatar visible on every page

test_cases.title: Sticky tabs with counts (WL-A2)
test_cases.steps: 1. Load watchlist with data. 2. Scroll the content.
test_cases.expected: Tabs remain pinned; counts equal ledger totals

test_cases.title: Stat strip totals (WL-A3)
test_cases.steps: 1. Note ledger watch count and alert count. 2. Read the strip.
test_cases.expected: Strip numbers match

test_cases.title: Bottom nav behaviour (WL-A4)
test_cases.steps: 1. Tap each of the five tabs. 2. Return to Watchlist.
test_cases.expected: Navigation works; Watchlist active state correct

test_cases.title: FAB page semantics (WL-A5)
test_cases.steps: 1. Tap + on Dashboard, Portfolio, Watchlist, Goals, More.
test_cases.expected: Add Bond opens on the first three; Goal form on Goals

test_cases.title: Rating Watch card (WL-B1)
test_cases.steps: 1. Seed a critical rating-watch alert. 2. Open watchlist.
test_cases.expected: Card shows Critical severity and advisory text

test_cases.title: Alert actions (WL-B2)
test_cases.steps: 1. Tap Read Advisory. 2. Tap Dismiss.
test_cases.expected: Advisory opens; card dismisses

test_cases.title: Form hidden on open (WL-C1)
test_cases.steps: 1. Fresh open of watchlist. 2. Tap FAB.
test_cases.expected: No form initially; form appears after tap

test_cases.title: ISIN fetch (WL-C2)
test_cases.steps: 1. Enter a valid 12-char ISIN. 2. Tap Fetch.
test_cases.expected: Fetch runs and a result state shows

test_cases.title: Fetch states (WL-C3)
test_cases.steps: 1. Trigger Found, Checking, Offline, Not Found outcomes.
test_cases.expected: Each state indicator renders correctly

test_cases.title: Duplicate ISIN blocked (WL-C4)
test_cases.steps: 1. Fetch an ISIN already active. 2. Attempt save.
test_cases.expected: Red banner with broker name; save blocked

test_cases.title: Identity autofill and lock (WL-C5)
test_cases.steps: 1. Complete a successful fetch. 2. Inspect section A.
test_cases.expected: Fields filled; ISIN chip locked

test_cases.title: Economics source chips (WL-C6)
test_cases.steps: 1. Render economics section.
test_cases.expected: Auto chips on auto fields; Yield empty

test_cases.title: Terms autofill (WL-C7)
test_cases.steps: 1. Complete fetch. 2. Inspect section C.
test_cases.expected: Issuer, listing, maturity filled with auto chips

test_cases.title: Credit day capture (WL-C8)
test_cases.steps: 1. Enter day 15. 2. Save. 3. Reopen.
test_cases.expected: Value 15 persists

test_cases.title: Default History disabled (WL-C9)
test_cases.steps: 1. Render terms section.
test_cases.expected: Field disabled with COMING SOON chip

test_cases.title: Secured helper (WL-C10)
test_cases.steps: 1. Render secured field.
test_cases.expected: Value plus senior-claim helper visible

test_cases.title: Targets empty default (WL-C11)
test_cases.steps: 1. Open fresh form. 2. Type targets.
test_cases.expected: Fields start empty and accept input

test_cases.title: Value per unit math (WL-C12)
test_cases.steps: 1. Enter target 500000 and qty 100. 2. Clear qty.
test_cases.expected: 5000 shows; then em-dash

test_cases.title: Broker free text (WL-C13)
test_cases.steps: 1. Type a custom broker name. 2. Save.
test_cases.expected: Accepted and saved

test_cases.title: Save watch entry (WL-C14)
test_cases.steps: 1. Fill valid form. 2. Tap Save.
test_cases.expected: Entry appears in ledger; note optional

test_cases.title: Company-first grouping (WL-D1)
test_cases.steps: 1. Seed company with held and watch ISINs. 2. Render ledger.
test_cases.expected: Single card contains both row types

test_cases.title: Status pill tiers (WL-D2)
test_cases.steps: 1. Render cards in each of four statuses.
test_cases.expected: Correct tier colour per status

test_cases.title: Header counts (WL-D3)
test_cases.steps: 1. Change position data. 2. Read header.
test_cases.expected: Amount and counts update to match

test_cases.title: Held row fields (WL-D4)
test_cases.steps: 1. Render held row.
test_cases.expected: Units, settled amount, countdown visible

test_cases.title: Watch row actions (WL-D5)
test_cases.steps: 1. Render watch row. 2. Tap Move. 3. Tap Details.
test_cases.expected: Meta/yield show; Move opens form; Details opens detail

test_cases.title: Compare card (WL-D6)
test_cases.steps: 1. Seed three brokers for one ISIN. 2. Render.
test_cases.expected: Yields list, Best Yield tagged, Select offered

test_cases.title: Buy-step line (WL-D7)
test_cases.steps: 1. Open compare card.
test_cases.expected: Buy-step line visible under Select

test_cases.title: NSDL browse (WL-D8)
test_cases.steps: 1. Tap Browse NSDL.
test_cases.expected: Depository list opens

test_cases.title: Move form inputs (WL-E1)
test_cases.steps: 1. Open Move from a watch row.
test_cases.expected: Four inputs empty and editable

test_cases.title: Goal attach (WL-E2)
test_cases.steps: 1. Select a goal during Move. 2. Confirm.
test_cases.expected: Position attached to goal

test_cases.title: Goals detour preserves state (WL-E3)
test_cases.steps: 1. Fill move form. 2. Detour to goals. 3. Return.
test_cases.expected: All values intact

test_cases.title: Confirm Move (WL-E4)
test_cases.steps: 1. Fill valid form. 2. Confirm.
test_cases.expected: Row becomes HELD/On-going with broker note

test_cases.title: Buried delete chain (WL-F1)
test_cases.steps: 1. Inspect cards for delete. 2. Walk Details to dialog.
test_cases.expected: No on-card delete; chain reaches dialog

test_cases.title: Overflow sheet actions (WL-F2)
test_cases.steps: 1. Open overflow menu.
test_cases.expected: Four actions; Remove red

test_cases.title: Type-ISIN guard (WL-F3)
test_cases.steps: 1. Wrong ISIN. 2. Correct ISIN short hold. 3. Correct ISIN 2s hold.
test_cases.expected: Blocked, blocked, removed

test_cases.title: Held-never-deleted note (WL-F4)
test_cases.steps: 1. Open guarded dialog.
test_cases.expected: Note line visible

test_cases.title: First-open defaults (WL-G1)
test_cases.steps: 1. Fresh install. 2. Open watchlist.
test_cases.expected: LEDGER active, form hidden, zero stats

test_cases.title: Empty state CTA (WL-G2)
test_cases.steps: 1. No data. 2. Tap Add first bond.
test_cases.expected: Placeholder shows; CTA opens form

test_cases.title: FAB route per page (WL-G3)
test_cases.steps: 1. Tap FAB on each page.
test_cases.expected: Correct form per page

changelog.note: v1.0 born from locked watchlist board + feature inventory; 40 requirements, 40 acceptance criteria, 40 test cases, 40 bindings; phase split MVP 32 / v1.1 8.
